notes.title: DEMO Update Patch Notes: Version 9.1
notes.notes:
Greetings Thieves,


This update brings more balance changes, a requested contract rework, and bug fixes:

Shadows of the Deep Rework– Reworked contract to include an additional easier path in the parkour section, reducing the overall difficulty of the contract based on player feedback. 

Shadows of the Deep Crystal Reduction– Reduced from 2,000 coins to 1,500 coins due to the above mentioned rework 

Key Pickup Sounds – Added new sound effects when picking up keys. 

Better Curse Descriptions – Updated for clearer explanations of their effects. 

Menu Cursor Bug Fix - Fixed an issue where menus couldn’t be exited by pressing Escape button while moving the mouse. 

Main Menu Bug Fix – Fixed a bug where players could get stuck in the Main Menu.

Finale Contract Bug Fix – Resolved a bug where the King’s Crown could spawn on the floor during the finale contract.

As always if you have any feedback or bugs to report, you can do so right here in Steam's own discussions page. Alternatively if you’d like to connect with fellow thieves and report bugs on the official Discord server you can join today.



Happy heisitng!

netDOT

notes.title: DEMO Update Patch Notes: Version 9.0
notes.notes:
Greetings Thieves,


This update focuses on quality of life improvements, balance changes, and a few visual upgrades: 

Scalable Difficulties – Re-worked Guard patrol, walk, and chase speeds. These vary much more between difficulties. Easy difficulty now serves as a gentler on-boarding experience, with each higher difficulty ramping up the challenge. 

Quest Item Spawning – Added new mechanics for how Quest items spawn during contracts. 

Tutorial Tooltips – New tooltips added to help players better understand game mechanics. 

New Loading Screen – A new loading screen has been added. 

Item Spawn Balance – Rebalanced spawn points for key items in the Curdled Plans contract. 

Map Improvements – Added new set decoration and props to the Curdled Plans contract. 

Quest Item Fixes – Fixed an issue where some quest items would fail to spawn correctly.

Curses Bug Fix – Resolved an issue where Increased Vision and Movement Speed curses weren’t being applied correctly. 

Contract Balance Changes – Quest items tied to contracts will no longer spawn inside Vaults.

As always if you have any feedback or bugs to report, you can do so right here in Steam's own discussions page. Alternatively if you’d like to connect with fellow thieves and report bugs on the official Discord server you can join today.



Happy heisitng!

netDOT

notes.title: DEMO Update Patch Notes: Version 8.9
notes.notes:
Greetings Thieves,


This update focuses on improving difficulty balance, player feedback, and a few quality-of-life tweaks:

AI Scaling on Easier Difficulties – Guards now have reduced line of sight, run speed, and patrol speed when playing on lower difficulties.

3D AI Footsteps – You’ll now be able to hear AI enemies moving around when they’re within a certain proximity.

Keybinding Options – All movement keys can now be rebound in the Keyboard & Mouse settings menu.

HUD Setting Change – The Enable Cinematic Mode option has been renamed to Hide All HUD Elements to avoid confusion.

Bug Fix – Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in the sewer water in the Rogues’ Den.

As always if you have any feedback or bugs to report, you can do so right here in Steam's own discussions page. Alternatively if you’d like to connect with fellow thieves and report bugs on the official Discord server you can join today.



Happy heisitng!

notes.title: DEMO Update Patch Notes: Version 8.8
notes.notes:
Greetings Thieves,


I’ve been working through more feedback and polish, this update adds a few helpful indicators, cosmetic tweaks, and bug fixes:

Clearer Host Indicators – Added better guidance for what the Server/Lobby host needs to do to progress Career mode.

Action Prompts – New indicators for voting and indication if you need to hold down a certain key to perform actions.

Map Cosmetic Tweaks – Small adjustments made to the Rogues’ Den lobby and the Curdled Plans contract.

Blueprints Renamed – Blueprints have been officially renamed to Schematics (since they’re not actually blue, duh).

Lobby Notifications – Fixed an issue where players joining a new lobby in the Rogues’ Den weren’t showing a message.

Clipping Fixes – Resolved a visual clipping bug in the Curdled Plans contract.

Sound Fixes – Fixed missing fire sound effects for some torches in the Curdled Plans contract.

As always if you have any feedback or bugs to report, you can do so right here in Steam's own discussions page. Alternatively if you’d like to connect with fellow thieves and report bugs on the official Discord server you can join today.

notes.title: DEMO Update Patch Notes: Version 8.6
notes.notes:
Greetings Thieves,


I’ve been reviewing more feedback from the Demo and have optimized a few more elements: 

Smarter AI Searching – Guards now actively hunt for Thieves for a short time after losing sight of them, making their behavior feel more believable (and more dangerous). 

New Guard Animations – When caught, Guards will now throw a punch before sending you to jail, giving clearer visual feedback that you’ve been caught. 

Dynamite Knockback – Standing too close when dynamite goes off will now knock you back. 

More HUD Notifications – Added additional on-screen messages for key events like players joining, leaving, being kicked, or disconnecting unexpectedly.

As always if you have any feedback or bugs to report, you can do so right here in Steam's own discussions page. Alternatively if you’d like to connect with fellow thieves and report bugs on the official Discord server you can join today.

notes.title: DEMO Hotfix Patch Notes: Version 8.4
notes.notes:
Greetings Thieves, 


Based on your feedback from the Demo, I’ve made a few small tweaks to improve movement and item interaction: 

HUD Indicator Added – Now shows when an input action is blocked, such as trying to pick up a heavy item while crouching.

Sprint Movement Adjustment – Reduced momentum loss when sprinting and jumping for a smoother flow.

Item Interaction Optimization – Picking up and dropping items should now feel more responsive and fluid.

I hope these changes make your time with the Demo even more enjoyable.



Happy heisting! 

netDOT
